name: NCAA D-I Southeast Regional Cross Country Championships
headline: NCAA D-I Southeast Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Seven ranked women's teams: No. 2 NC State, No. 9 South Carolina, No. 12 Clemson, No. 14 Virginia Tech, No. 18 North Carolina, No. 19 Duke and No. 22 Virginia. Men: No. 9 Wake Forest, No. 15 Virginia Tech, No. 18 Eastern Kentucky and No. 23 Furman. The top two teams and the top four individuals not on those teams qualify automatically for the NCAA Championships on Nov. 21. · Women 6K 10:00 a.m. ET · Men 10K 11:00 a.m. ET
